notes: Stitcher: 'Sound-sync examples…' looks at 300 clips of the folder picked at random, says how many have sound that is longer or shorter than the picture, fixes a few of them the way a join does (picture untouched, sound matched to it) and puts original and fixed side by side in Breezy Output > Sync examples, with the measured lengths. The originals are not touched.
Stitcher: joins that re-sync the sound no longer leave an empty hidden folder behind.
